answer: The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Every entry must show Amethystbound anvil keeper gold licence before the ledger opens, because a licence anvil keepers carry after gold shop audits. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Each name is charged $83 in fees and a 3-day delay before the stamp dries, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. One summit, one entry. Every ocean is counted once. The wander is checked, not assumed.
